name: principalloop
description: Verifiable resume points for Codex: checkpoint the files your work relies on, then see exactly what changed before continuing.

interface.longDescription: Save a checkpoint of the files you choose plus a short note. When you or another chat come back, PrincipalLoop compares every tracked file byte for byte and shows what changed, with the captured version still readable. Local SQLite, no model calls, no network. You decide which files are tracked.
defaultPrompt: Save a PrincipalLoop checkpoint of this work
What changed since my last checkpoint?
Is PrincipalLoop enabled for this project?
